about: Performance budgets (spec WP-102), checked by scripts/check-budgets.mjs after every production deploy. `weights` are exact, measured on what the page downloads: each is what the production runner measured on 2026-10-10 (after the lazy chat engine and the zod fix) plus 10-15% headroom — a ratchet: it only ever moves down, and a breach FAILS the check. `lab` are Lighthouse targets from the spec; they are noisy, so a breach only WARNS until the variance on a quiet runner is known (decision log D-027). Tighten a number by editing it here — never in code. Sprint 1c (2026-10-21, D-041): /systems, /journey and /about carry their own hero image, so their total and image budgets rose by that image (110, 40 and 42 KB) and one request each; /contact's followed with its image (+30 KB, +1 request). One deliberate exception to only-down: the home page's largest image is 125 KB, not 90, from the Sprint 1b release (2026-10-20) — the hero's cover image (92.8 KiB desktop, 117 KiB phone: the phone image is sharper and fills the whole hero) is the page's largest paint on purpose (HOME-HERO-PLAN §15, D-034), and its weight is also a law in tests/integration/home-hero.test.ts.
